answer: Each key must redeem a one-time code printed on a paper postcard the protocol mails to a deliverable street address, re-mailed every 60 days. Addresses are normalized and salted-hashed, so one mailbox backs one seat. To forge 100 aliases you need 100 real drops; a mail-forwarding box is ~$10/mo, so ~$12k/yr, and known forwarding (CMRA) addresses are flagged. A falcon-eyed check: an island of codes redeemed from one IP block within minutes triggers a re-mail to fresh addresses.
